lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਠਠਾ ਮਨੂਆ ਠਾਹਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: thathaa manooaa thaahahi naahee ||
lines.translation: T'HAT'HA: Those who have abandoned all else,

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਸਗਲ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਏਕਹਿ ਲਪਟਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo sagal tiaag ekahi lapataahee ||
lines.translation: and who cling to the One Lord alone, do not make trouble for anyone's mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਠਹਕਿ ਠਹਕਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਸੰਗਿ ਮੂਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: thahak thahak maaiaa sa(n)g mooe ||
lines.translation: Those who are totally absorbed and preoccupied with Maya are dead;

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਆ ਕੈ ਕੁਸਲ ਨ ਕਤਹੂ ਹੂਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: uaa kai kusal na katahoo hooe ||
lines.translation: they do not find happiness anywhere.

lines.gurmukhi: ਠਾਂਢਿ ਪਰੀ ਸੰਤਹ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਸਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: thaa(n)dh paree sa(n)tah sa(n)g basiaa ||
lines.translation: One who dwells in the Society of the Saints finds a great peace;

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਤਹਾ ਜੀਅ ਰਸਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)mrit naam tahaa jee rasiaa ||
lines.translation: the Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam becomes sweet to his soul.

lines.gurmukhi: ਠਾਕੁਰ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਜੋ ਜਨੁ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: thaakur apune jo jan bhaaiaa ||
lines.translation: That humble being, who is pleasing to his Lord and Master

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਉਆ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤਲਾਇਆ ॥੨੮॥
lines.transliteration: naanak uaa kaa man seetalaaiaa ||28||
lines.translation: - O Nanak, his mind is cooled and soothed. ||28||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok ||
lines.translation: Salok:

lines.gurmukhi: ਡੰਡਉਤਿ ਬੰਦਨ ਅਨਿਕ ਬਾਰ ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ ਸਮਰਥ ॥
lines.transliteration: da(n)daut ba(n)dan anik baar sarab kalaa samarath ||
lines.translation: I bow down, and fall to the ground in humble adoration, countless times, to the All-powerful Lord, who possesses all powers.

lines.gurmukhi: ਡੋਲਨ ਤੇ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨਾਨਕ ਦੇ ਕਰਿ ਹਥ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: dolan te raakhahu prabhoo naanak de kar hath ||1||
lines.translation: Please protect me, and save me from wandering, God. Reach out and give Nanak Your Hand. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਡਡਾ ਡੇਰਾ ਇਹੁ ਨਹੀ ਜਹ ਡੇਰਾ ਤਹ ਜਾਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: dadaa deraa ihu nahee jah deraa tah jaan ||
lines.translation: DADDA: This is not your true place; you must know where that place really is.

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਆ ਡੇਰਾ ਕਾ ਸੰਜਮੋ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: uaa deraa kaa sa(n)jamo gur kai sabad pachhaan ||
lines.translation: You shall come to realize the way to that place, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਆ ਡੇਰਾ ਕਉ ਸ੍ਰਮੁ ਕਰਿ ਘਾਲੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: iaa deraa kau sram kar ghaalai ||
lines.translation: This place, here, is established by hard work,

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਾ ਤਸੂ ਨਹੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਚਾਲੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa kaa tasoo nahee sa(n)g chaalai ||
lines.translation: but not one iota of this shall go there with you.

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਆ ਡੇਰਾ ਕੀ ਸੋ ਮਿਤਿ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: uaa deraa kee so mit jaanai ||
lines.translation: The value of that place beyond is known only to those,

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਭਗਵਾਨੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa kau drisat pooran bhagavaanai ||
lines.translation: upon whom the Perfect Lord God casts His Glance of Grace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਡੇਰਾ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: deraa nihachal sach saadhasa(n)g paaiaa ||
lines.translation: That permanent and true place is obtained in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy;

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇ ਜਨ ਨਹ ਡੋਲਾਇਆ ॥੨੯॥
lines.transliteration: naanak te jan nah dolaaiaa ||29||
lines.translation: O Nanak, those humble beings do not waver or wander. ||29||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok ||
lines.translation: Salok:

lines.gurmukhi: ਢਾਹਨ ਲਾਗੇ ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਕਿਨਹਿ ਨ ਘਾਲਿਓ ਬੰਧ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhaahan laage dharam raai kinahi na ghaalio ba(n)dh ||
lines.translation: When the Righteous Judge of Dharma begins to destroy someone, no one can place any obstacle in His Way.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਉਬਰੇ ਜਪਿ ਹਰੀ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਸਨਬੰਧ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak ubare jap haree saadhasa(n)g sanaba(n)dh ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, those who join the Saadh Sangat and meditate on the Lord are saved. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਢਢਾ ਢੂਢਤ ਕਹ ਫਿਰਹੁ ਢੂਢਨੁ ਇਆ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhadhaa dhoodhat kah phirahu dhoodhan iaa man maahi ||
lines.translation: DHADHA: Where are you going, wandering and searching? Search instead within your own mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਗਿ ਤੁਹਾਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਬਸੈ ਬਨੁ ਬਨੁ ਕਹਾ ਫਿਰਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)g tuhaarai prabh basai ban ban kahaa phiraahi ||
lines.translation: God is with you, so why do you wander around from forest to forest?

lines.gurmukhi: ਢੇਰੀ ਢਾਹਹੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਅਹੰਬੁਧਿ ਬਿਕਰਾਲ ॥
lines.transliteration: dheree dhaahahu saadhasa(n)g aha(n)budh bikaraal ||
lines.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, tear down the mound of your frightful, egotistical pride.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਸਹਜੇ ਬਸਹੁ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥
lines.transliteration: sukh paavahu sahaje basahu darasan dekh nihaal ||
lines.translation: You shall find peace, and abide in intuitive bliss; gazing upon the Blessed Vision of God's Darshan, you shall be delighted.

lines.gurmukhi: ਢੇਰੀ ਜਾਮੈ ਜਮਿ ਮਰੈ ਗਰਭ ਜੋਨਿ ਦੁਖ ਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: dheree jaamai jam marai garabh jon dukh paai ||
lines.translation: One who has such a mound as this, dies and suffers the pain of reincarnation through the womb.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੋਹ ਮਗਨ ਲਪਟਤ ਰਹੈ ਹਉ ਹਉ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: moh magan lapatat rahai hau hau aavai jaai ||
lines.translation: One who is intoxicated by emotional attachment, entangled in egotism, selfishness and conceit, shall continue coming and going in reincarnation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਢਹਤ ਢਹਤ ਅਬ ਢਹਿ ਪਰੇ ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਸਰਨਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhahat dhahat ab dhahi pare saadh janaa saranaai ||
lines.translation: Slowly and steadily, I have now surrendered to the Holy Saints; I have come to their Sanctuary.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਖ ਕੇ ਫਾਹੇ ਕਾਟਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਲੀਏ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੩੦॥
lines.transliteration: dukh ke phaahe kaatiaa naanak leee samaai ||30||
lines.translation: God has cut away the noose of my pain; O Nanak, He has merged me into Himself. ||30||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok ||
lines.translation: Salok:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਸਾਧੂ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਭਜਨੁ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਨੀਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: jah saadhoo gobid bhajan keeratan naanak neet ||
lines.translation: Where the Holy people constantly vibrate the Kirtan of the Praises of the Lord of the Universe, O Nanak

lines.gurmukhi: ਣਾ ਹਉ ਣਾ ਤੂੰ ਣਹ ਛੁਟਹਿ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨ ਜਾਈਅਹੁ ਦੂਤ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naa hau naa too(n) nah chhutahi nikat na jaaeeahu doot ||1||
lines.translation: - the Righteous Judge says, "Do not approach that place, O Messenger of Death, or else neither you nor I shall escape!" ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਣਾਣਾ ਰਣ ਤੇ ਸੀਝੀਐ ਆਤਮ ਜੀਤੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanaa ran te seejheeai aatam jeetai koi ||
lines.translation: NANNA: One who conquers his own soul, wins the battle of life.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਅਨ ਸਿਉ ਲਰਿ ਮਰੈ ਸੋ ਸੋਭਾ ਦੂ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: haumai an siu lar marai so sobhaa doo hoi ||
lines.translation: One who dies, while fighting against egotism and alienation, becomes sublime and beautiful.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਣੀ ਮਿਟਾਇ ਜੀਵਤ ਮਰੈ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਉਪਦੇਸ ॥
lines.transliteration: manee mitaai jeevat marai gur poore upades ||
lines.translation: One who eradicates his ego, remains dead while yet alive, through the Teachings of the Perfect Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੂਆ ਜੀਤੈ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਿਹ ਸੂਰਤਣ ਵੇਸ ॥
lines.transliteration: manooaa jeetai har milai tih sooratan ves ||
lines.translation: He conquers his mind, and meets the Lord; he is dressed in robes of honor.

lines.gurmukhi: ਣਾ ਕੋ ਜਾਣੈ ਆਪਣੋ ਏਕਹਿ ਟੇਕ ਅਧਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: naa ko jaanai aapano ekahi tek adhaar ||
lines.translation: He does not claim anything as his own; the One Lord is his Anchor and Support.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੈਣਿ ਦਿਣਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਰਹੈ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: rain dinas simarat rahai so prabh purakh apaar ||
lines.translation: Night and day, he continually contemplates the Almighty, Infinite Lord God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੇਣ ਸਗਲ ਇਆ ਮਨੁ ਕਰੈ ਏਊ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ren sagal iaa man karai eoo karam kamaai ||
lines.translation: He makes his mind the dust of all; such is the karma of the deeds he does.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਪਾਇ ॥੩੧॥
lines.transliteration: hukamai boojhai sadaa sukh naanak likhiaa paai ||31||
lines.translation: Understanding the Hukam of the Lord's Command, he attains everlasting peace. O Nanak, such is his pre-ordained destiny. ||31||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok ||
lines.translation: Salok:

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਅਰਪਉ ਤਿਸੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ਮੋਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: tan man dhan arapau tisai prabhoo milaavai mohi ||
lines.translation: I offer my body, mind and wealth to anyone who can unite me with God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭਉ ਕਾਟੀਐ ਚੂਕੈ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਜੋਹ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak bhram bhau kaateeai chookai jam kee joh ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, my doubts and fears have been dispelled, and the Messenger of Death does not see me any longer. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਤਾ ਤਾ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਿ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਰਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: tataa taa siu preet kar gun nidh gobid raai ||
lines.translation: TATTA: Embrace love for the Treasure of Excellence, the Sovereign Lord of the Universe.

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਲ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮਨ ਬਾਛਤੇ ਤਪਤਿ ਤੁਹਾਰੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: phal paavahi man baachhate tapat tuhaaree jaai ||
lines.translation: You shall obtain the fruits of your mind's desires, and your burning thirst shall be quenched.
